children: UK low-cost gym operator's H1 revenue grew 10% yr/yr, driven by higher membership and yield
Adjusted EPS for H1 rose 21% yr/yr
Company completed £3.8 mln of planned £10 mln share buyback in H1
Company expects 3% like-for-like revenue growth for the full yr
Like-for-like cost growth now seen at lower end of 3-4% guided range
Company expects full-yr Group Adjusted EBITDA Less Normalised Rent at top end of analysts' forecast range
MEMBERSHIP GROWTH - Co said 5% higher average membership numbers and targeted acquisition initiatives drove revenue gains
YIELD IMPROVEMENT - Co attributed 5% yield growth to sustained pricing opportunity, price increases for new members, and selective repricing
SITE DESIGN AND REFURBISHMENT - Co said elevated site design and refurbishment led to performance gains and incremental membership growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 9 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the leisure & recreation peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for GYM Group PLC is GBp250.00, about 29.5% above its September 8 closing price of GBp193.00
The stock recently traded at 36 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 36 three months ago
